name: primitives-headless-dialog

frames.best_why: The dialog is fully settled with the title, description and both action buttons sharp and readable.

tagline: A confirmation panel tilts open inside a blurred dark page.
summary: A white Open Dialog button opens a dark panel warning that a project will be archived, with a short explanation and Cancel and Archive actions; it tilts in with a blur.
appearance: A dark rounded panel centred on a dimmed page, headed Archive this project? in bold white, with three lines of grey explanation and two buttons at the bottom right: an outlined Cancel and a white Archive.
behaviour: Clicking Open Dialog drops a softly blurred black backdrop over the page and tilts the panel in from the top with a spring, sharpening as it settles. Cancel, Archive, Escape or a backdrop click close it the same way in reverse.
demo_content: Heading Archive this project?, a note about a redesign's 48 tasks moving to the archive, plus Cancel and Archive.
search_phrases: warning box before deleting a project
modal with cancel and confirm buttons
alert dialog for a destructive action
use_when: A destructive or irreversible action needs a confirming panel with explanation and two choices.
avoid_when: It is renderless, so every bit of spacing, colour and button styling has to be written by you.
customise: Open state, close handler and every part are passed in; panel direction, spring, backdrop transition and class names are props while the inner markup is yours.
weight_why: One backdrop and one panel animate; nothing runs while closed.

a11y.note: Focus is trapped, Escape closes and the title and description are wired up, but no focus-visible styles or reduced-motion check are included.

issues: Cancel's outline is faint against the dark panel, so the secondary action is easy to miss.
In frame 3 the trigger button ghosts through the still-transparent panel while opening.
polish_why: Clean panel and a distinctive tilt-in; faint Cancel outline and opening ghosting are minor.
